answerGuide: • Colombe is quiet, and very different from her sister, Alice.
• People don’t notice her.
• She likes everything to be tidy and in order, so she keeps her bed made, her clothes tidy, and her books arranged in alphabetical order.
• She doesn’t give out to Alice about her untidiness, but just ignores it.
• She’s secretive, as she hides the fact that she’s writing a novel from her parents and sister, and hides the exercise books she uses in a drawer.
• She is a perfectionist, as she wants to finish, correct and type out the manuscript.
• She is dreamy: imagines an editor phoning her to say he will publish the novel.
• She is sensitive and easily hurt when Alice and Myriam read her novel, and she thinks it isn’t good enough.
• She is devious: she pretends she had only just arrived home, and made sure she made noise, and she lied about her teacher being ill.
Etc., etc.
